description: [Tracker] Undo one Tracker event that the user names: retract a single stage change, note or other event by its eventId, as the undo on the /tracker board does. Only call it when the user asked to undo that specific event; never to clean up or to retry. The event stays in history marked as retracted and the entry's stage is recomputed. Retracting an already retracted event changes nothing. The only stage event of an entry, and a retraction itself, cannot be retracted. Returns not_found, tracker_unavailable or version_conflict without writing anything.

applicationId.description: Tracker entry ID from trackly_list_tracker_applications. Pass exactly one of applicationId or jobId.

context.description: Briefly explain why this tool helps the current job-search goal. Never include resume text, profile answers, demographic or work-authorization answers, application notes, credentials, or secrets.

eventId.description: The one event to retract, from trackly_list_tracker_applications with applicationId, or the stageEventId or noteEventId a write returned.

jobId.description: Trackly job posting ID. Resolved to its Tracker entry. Pass exactly one of applicationId or jobId.

name: trackly_retract_tracker_event
title: Tracker · Undo an event
